scenarios.source: The skill's hardest rule and the one most easily broken: „Nehodnoť a nenavrhuj. Ani jedna věta." Plus the access problem it is written for — no code, no admin — which is the normal case for a produkťák.
scenarios.why_this_scenario: Once one solution enters the mapping, the rest of the document quietly collects support for it. The person here asks for a solution outright at the end, which is the moment the rule is worth something. The missing access also has to become named questions instead of a dead end, and a documentation claim must not be reported as implemented behaviour.
must: Says up front which sources it can reach and what it needs from the person, before starting
Turns the missing code and admin access into named questions for a role, not a dead end
Keeps „model to dovoluje" separate from „je to naimplementované" for the doplňková varianta
Every finding carries its source and a Co nevíme line
Refuses the request for a solution and parks the idea in the note at the end
Surfaces „existuje, ale nepoužívá se" directly under the summary if the doplňková varianta turns out unused
must_not: Proposes, evaluates or recommends a solution, even when asked directly
Reports a documentation claim as implemented behaviour
Enters the admin, or claims to have seen a screen it was never shown
Silently skips a side it cannot map instead of naming the gap
scenarios.qualitative: The person explicitly asks for a proposal. Does the refusal come with something more useful — the questions that would let them decide — or does it just decline?
